comparison_pairs.label: Primary read vs Comparison read

takeaways: On this fixed LLY Item 1A pair, moving from the control read to the primary read materially improves specificity, novelty separation, and auditability without changing the tagged evidence substrate.

Holding the i2 tagged substrate fixed while moving from the primary read to the comparison read shows that protocol framing alone changes which pricing, access, concentration, and policy risks lead the read.
This remains a bounded three-read case view, not a broad multi-company comparison framework.
caveats: This is a single-issuer, single-year-pair case comparison, not a benchmark.
B0 is an honest ad hoc recovered control lane and should not be read as a canonical structured run.
No clean traceable 01 reuse-filtered lane exists for LLY in this wave, so the matrix intentionally stays three-lane.
